content:
Connor O’Brien: Kicking off coordination for the first end-to-end Private upgrade rehearsal in staging. Goal is to run the *full* workflow (prechecks -> backup verify -> staged apply -> health gates -> smoke tests) and validate we can rollback cleanly.

Connor O’Brien: Proposed window: Thu 2:00–3:30pm PT. Staging env: `private-stg-vpc-03` (EKS). Target upgrade: `private-1.12.0-rc3` (from `1.11.2`).

Connor O’Brien: Owners (draft):
- Driver / comms: me
- Installer/CLI: Devon
- Control plane / version reporting / gates: Ethan
- SRE monitoring + go/no-go: Sean + Rafael
- Test matrix + failure injection (light): Leila
- CI artifacts + build provenance: Sahana
- Security signoff for bundle verification behavior: Marcus

Sean Gallagher: Works for me. Can we make the go/no-go criteria explicit before we get in the room? Last time we “winged it” and got stuck in “is this bad?” land.

Connor O’Brien: Yep. Draft go/no-go at T-10:
1) Precheck report all PASS/WARN only (no FAIL).
2) Snapshot permissions check passes (IAM) + DB snapshot created + verification step returns OK.
3) Upgrade plan graph matches expected component ordering (CP -> runtime -> gateway -> obs agents).
4) SLOs stable for 10 min pre-start (baseline).
5) Rollback path confirmed available (previous versions present in repo + snapshot restore OK).

Rafael Mendes: Add “pager coverage” and “change window comms” even for staging. If this knocks out shared staging it blocks other teams.

Connor O’Brien: Good call. I’ll post in #eng-private-deployments and #eng-sre day-of. Also will set a temporary freeze on staging changes during the window.

Sahana Iyer: On artifacts: `1.12.0-rc3` is in the private registry, signed. I can confirm provenance and the installer verification behavior is on by default in this build. Do we also want to test the “signature invalid” path or keep that separate?

Connor O’Brien: Separate for now. This rehearsal is “happy-ish path” + one controlled failure injection (Leila’s pick) *during* upgrade to validate abort/rollback UX.

Leila Farouk: For controlled failure: recommend “simulate image pull fail for gateway” or “disk pressure on node for backup step”?

Sean Gallagher: Please not disk pressure unless we’re really confident it won’t wedge the cluster for hours. Gateway image pull fail is easier to recover.

Leila Farouk: +1. I can patch the gateway image tag to a nonexistent digest right before that step, then revert once we validate rollback triggers.

Devon Price: Reminder: new CLI has `upgrade plan` and `upgrade apply` with correlation id. For rehearsal, I want to run with `--emit-diagnostics` so we capture the tarball regardless.

Ethan Park: On ordering: control plane API now reports component versions and compatibility. If the installer sees a forward-only migration flag, rollback should be blocked w/ explicit prompt. Staging should be reversible for this version jump (no forward-only).

Marcus Lin: Re: security signoff for this run: as long as we’re using signed artifacts and verification stays enabled, I’m good. Please don’t disable verification to “get it done”. If verification fails, that’s a stop.

Connor O’Brien: Agreed. Any verification failure = no-go and we file a bug.

Aisha Bello: For monitoring, I’ll share a temp dashboard link for upgrade metrics (step durations + failure counts). In staging we don’t have full alerting wired but we can watch:
- `private_upgrade_step_duration_seconds`
- `private_upgrade_step_failures_total`
- gateway 5xx rate
- control plane ready/health endpoint

Rafael Mendes: Can someone confirm *exact* smoke tests? “Looks healthy” isn’t enough.

Ethan Park: Suggested smoke test sequence post-upgrade:
1) `kubectl -n redwood-private get pods` all Running/Ready
2) call CP health: `curl -fsS https://<cp>/healthz`
3) run minimal inference request through gateway (chat + embeddings)
4) check audit log emits upgrade event with correlation id

Devon Price: I can provide the exact commands we used in PR testing:
```
redwood-private upgrade plan --target 1.12.0-rc3 --cluster private-stg-vpc-03
redwood-private precheck run --cluster private-stg-vpc-03 --json > precheck.json
redwood-private upgrade apply --target 1.12.0-rc3 --cluster private-stg-vpc-03 --emit-diagnostics
```
And rollback:
```
redwood-private upgrade rollback --cluster private-stg-vpc-03
```

Sean Gallagher: For go/no-go, add hard timeouts. If a gate sits Pending > X mins, we should abort rather than “wait it out”.

Connor O’Brien: What thresholds?

Sean Gallagher: Proposal (staging):
- Any single step > 12 min => pause + assess
- Total upgrade > 45 min => abort and rollback
- Gateway 5xx > 1% for > 5 min during post-upgrade smoke => rollback

Aisha Bello: Works. Also watch etcd / DB latency if we can. Backup verification step should include a quick restore dry run (or at least checksum validation).

Devon Price: The backup step currently does snapshot + “list/describe snapshot” verification + simple query check against restored temp instance is *not* implemented yet. So for now it’s checksum + snapshot state = completed.

Rafael Mendes: That’s fine for rehearsal; just document the limitation in the notes.

Markus Klein: FYI Solutions wants to observe this rehearsal (for beta readiness). I’ll join silently unless needed.

Connor O’Brien: Cool. I’ll send calendar invite w/ notes + Zoom.

Connor O’Brien: Pre-reqs checklist before Thu:
- Devon: confirm staging installer build is `v0.18.0` w/ rollback command available
- Ethan: confirm CP `/versions` endpoint deployed in staging
- Sahana: confirm artifact availability + signatures for target version
- Aisha: dashboard link + which panels to pin during the run
- Leila: failure injection plan written down (exact change + revert)
- Sean/Rafael: confirm on-call coverage + who declares go/no-go

Sahana Iyer: Confirmed: `private-1.12.0-rc3` artifacts in registry. Signature verification uses the current staging key. I’ll post SHA + provenance details tomorrow morning.

Ethan Park: CP endpoint is in staging as of this afternoon. I’ll verify the payload includes runtime/gateway chart versions and compat set.

Devon Price: Installer build `v0.18.0` is deployed to the staging runner. I’ll do a dry run of `upgrade plan` today and paste output in thread.

deploy-bot: Devon Price ran workflow `private-installer-staging` on `private-stg-vpc-03` (job: upgrade-plan). Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/jobs/784211

deploy-bot: Output artifact: `upgrade-plan-private-stg-vpc-03-1739476122.txt`

Devon Price: Plan output looks correct: precheck -> backup -> cp -> migrations job -> runtime -> gateway -> obs agent update -> smoke test job. No unexpected parallelism.

Leila Farouk: Failure injection details:
- At step `gateway-rollout`, set `gateway.image.tag` to `does-not-exist` in the upgrade values override
- Expect: installer detects rollout timeout, marks step failed, prompts for rollback
- After rollback validated, revert the override and re-run upgrade without injection (if time)

Sean Gallagher: Love it. Make sure rollback restores gateway to previous tag and traffic stabilizes.

Connor O’Brien: Decision log (so we don’t debate live):
- If injection causes failures outside gateway (CP crash loops, DB issues), we abort and restore snapshot before attempting anything else.

Marcus Lin: One more: if any step suggests turning off signature verification, the answer is no. Raise in thread and we reschedule.

Connor O’Brien: Noted.

Rafael Mendes: Who’s the “single throat” for calling rollback? It can’t be 6 people typing commands.

Connor O’Brien: Devon is hands-on keyboard. Sean is final go/no-go + “execute rollback now” call. I’ll coordinate comms and keep the notes.

Aisha Bello: I’ll be watching the dashboard and will call out anomalies. Please make sure correlation id is visible in CP logs, we want to validate tracing across services.

Ethan Park: Correlation id propagation is enabled in staging. Should show in CP logs as `upgrade_correlation_id=<id>`.

Connor O’Brien: Great. I’ll compile this into a mini run sheet and paste it here the morning of. If anyone sees a blocker, flag by EOD Wed.

Sean Gallagher: :thumbsup:

Sahana Iyer: :thumbsup:

Devon Price: :thumbsup:

Leila Farouk: :thumbsup:

Marcus Lin: :thumbsup:
